free_tier_limits.notes: Free tier is a limited-time trial via Usage Credits. Credits are non-transferable, non-refundable, expire on account termination, and require upgrade to Paid Service once exhausted. No permanent free tier.

tos_analysis.license_scope: worldwide, non-exclusive, non-sublicensable, non-transferable license for Content only (download/display locally). No license granted for Service infrastructure reselling.
tos_analysis.assignment: Prohibited without prior written consent from Railway. Railway may assign freely.
tos_analysis.enterprise_exception: Enterprise Agreement exists but governs enterprise customer-affiliated workspaces under separate contract; not available via public free tier or self-service signup.
tos_analysis.acceptable_use: Use prohibited if violating applicable laws. No explicit managed service/reseller exception in public TOS.
tos_analysis.credits_restrictions: Usage Credits have no cash value, are non-transferrable, non-refundable, expire immediately on cancellation/termination.

risks: No permanent free tier — trial-only model violates zero-capital sustainability requirement
Non-sublicensable, non-transferable license blocks any resale or managed service wrapper
Assignment clause prohibits account/service transfer without written consent
Usage Credits are non-transferable and expire on termination — cannot be pooled or resold
Enterprise Agreement is gated (not self-service) and terms are opaque
next_steps: REJECTED — do not proceed to TIER1
Continue pipeline with Fly.io, Vercel, Netlify evaluation
